title: Patchboard
user: Creative coders learning Web Audio who need to hear and inspect a small signal graph before embedding it in a performance or toy.
smallest_useful_product: Static web patchboard with six native nodes, animated signal path, BPM scheduler, click-to-hear A/B changes, and shareable URL fragment.
constraints: Use only synthesized sound; reduce-motion option; autoplay requires a user gesture; no microphone permission in v1.
